+# Simple quotients of finite subdirect products
+
+## Abstract
+
+A prescribed nonabelian simple quotient of a finite subdirect product factors through one coordinate.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Factorization of the prescribed quotient).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/NikolovSegal/SubdirectSimpleFactorization.subdirect_simple_factorization`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/NikolovSegal/SubdirectSimpleFactorization.subdirect_simple_factorization` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Let B be an actual subgroup of a finite dependent product of groups, and suppose that every restricted coordinate projection is surjective. Fix a surjective homomorphism theta from B onto a nonabelian simple group F. There is a coordinate i and a homomorphism from the whole factor A i to F whose composite with the restricted coordinate projection is theta. Neither the factor groups nor F is required to be finite.
+
+The proof treats finite jointly separating families of homomorphisms. After splitting off one coordinate, the other coordinates are replaced by their actual joint range. The two resulting kernels commute. Their images under theta are normal in F, and simplicity makes each image trivial or all of F. Both images cannot be all of F, since that would make F abelian. Thus theta descends through one of the two maps. Descent through the joint range reduces the number of coordinates; its coordinate maps remain surjective. The empty family would make the source trivial, contrary to surjectivity onto F.
+
+The joint range may be a proper subgroup of the remaining product. Keeping that range preserves all compatibility conditions among the coordinates. The resulting statement concerns the original homomorphism theta, rather than merely an unspecified simple section of some factor. It is an abstract group statement and supplies no geometric realization of a surface quotient or an outer action.
+
+## References
+
+- Truth anchor: `D5/S3/FiniteGroups/NikolovSegal/SubdirectSimpleFactorization.subdirect_simple_factorization`

+import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Subgroup.Basic
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Pi.Lemmas
+import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Subgroup.Simple
+import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Option
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+namespace NikolovSegal
+
+universe u v w z
+
+/-- Two jointly separating homomorphisms have commuting kernels. A prescribed
+surjection onto a nonabelian simple group therefore kills one of those kernels. -/
+private theorem killed_kernel_of_separating_pair
+    {G : Type u} {L : Type v} {R : Type z} {F : Type w}
+    [Group G] [Group L] [Group R] [Group F] [IsSimpleGroup F]
+    (noncomm : ¬ ∀ x y : F, x * y = y * x)
+    (p : G →* L) (q : G →* R)
+    (separate : ∀ x y : G, p x = p y → q x = q y → x = y)
+    (theta : G →* F) (theta_onto : Function.Surjective theta) :
+    p.ker ≤ theta.ker ∨ q.ker ≤ theta.ker := by
+  haveI : (p.ker.map theta).Normal :=
+    Subgroup.Normal.map inferInstance theta theta_onto
+  haveI : (q.ker.map theta).Normal :=
+    Subgroup.Normal.map inferInstance theta theta_onto
+  rcases Subgroup.Normal.eq_bot_or_eq_top (p.ker.map theta) with hp | hp
+  · left
+    intro x hx
+    have hmem : theta x ∈ p.ker.map theta := Subgroup.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
+    rw [hp, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
+    exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr hmem
+  · rcases Subgroup.Normal.eq_bot_or_eq_top (q.ker.map theta) with hq | hq
+    · right
+      intro x hx
+      have hmem : theta x ∈ q.ker.map theta := Subgroup.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
+      rw [hq, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hmem
+      exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr hmem
+    · exfalso
+      apply noncomm
+      intro a b
+      have ha : a ∈ p.ker.map theta := hp ▸ Subgroup.mem_top a
+      have hb : b ∈ q.ker.map theta := hq ▸ Subgroup.mem_top b
+      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp ha
+      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hb
+      have hx' : p x = 1 := MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hx
+      have hy' : q y = 1 := MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hy
+      have hxy : x * y = y * x := separate _ _
+        (by simp only [map_mul, hx', one_mul, mul_one])
+        (by simp only [map_mul, hy', one_mul, mul_one])
+      simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg theta hxy
+
+/-- Let an actual subgroup of a finite dependent product project onto every
+factor. Every prescribed surjection from that subgroup onto a nonabelian simple
+group factors through one of those coordinate projections. The factor groups
+and the simple target may be infinite, and the index type may be empty. -/
+theorem subdirect_simple_factorization
+    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (A : ι → Type v) [∀ i, Group (A i)]
+    {F : Type w} [Group F] [IsSimpleGroup F]
+    (noncomm : ¬ ∀ x y : F, x * y = y * x)
+    (B : Subgroup (∀ i, A i))
+    (onto : ∀ i, Function.Surjective ((Pi.evalMonoidHom A i).comp B.subtype))
+    (theta : B →* F) (theta_onto : Function.Surjective theta) :
+    ∃ i : ι, ∃ phi : A i →* F, ∀ b : B, theta b = phi (b.val i) := by
+  classical
+  let P : Type u → Prop := fun I =>
+    ∀ (G : Type (max u v)) [Group G]
+      (K : I → Type v) [∀ i, Group (K i)] (p : ∀ i, G →* K i),
+      (∀ i, Function.Surjective (p i)) →
+      (∀ x y : G, (∀ i, p i x = p i y) → x = y) →
+      ∀ (f : G →* F), Function.Surjective f →
+        ∃ i : I, ∃ phi : K i →* F, ∀ x : G, f x = phi (p i x)
+  have hfinite : P ι := by
+    apply Finite.induction_empty_option (P := P) _ _ _ ι
+    · intro I J e ih G _ K _ p hp hs f hf
+      have hs' : ∀ x y : G, (∀ i, p (e i) x = p (e i) y) → x = y := by
+        intro x y hxy
+        apply hs x y
+        intro j
+        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := e.surjective j
+        exact hxy i
+      obtain ⟨i, phi, hphi⟩ := ih G (fun i => K (e i))
+        (fun i => p (e i)) (fun i => hp (e i)) hs' f hf
+      exact ⟨e i, phi, hphi⟩
+    · intro G _ K _ p hp hs f hf
+      have hF : Subsingleton F := by
+        constructor
+        intro a b
+        obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hf a
+        obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hf b
+        exact congrArg f (hs x y (fun i => nomatch i))
+      exact False.elim (not_subsingleton F hF)
+    · intro I _ ih G _ K _ p hp hs f hf
+      let r : G →* (∀ i : I, K (some i)) :=
+        { toFun := fun x i => p (some i) x
+          map_one' := funext (fun i => (p (some i)).map_one)
+          map_mul' := fun x y => funext (fun i => (p (some i)).map_mul x y) }
+      have hsep : ∀ x y : G, p none x = p none y →
+          r.rangeRestrict x = r.rangeRestrict y → x = y := by
+        intro x y hnone hrest
+        apply hs x y
+        intro j
+        cases j with
+        | none => exact hnone
+        | some i => exact congrArg (fun t : r.range => t.val i) hrest
+      rcases killed_kernel_of_separating_pair noncomm (p none)
+          r.rangeRestrict hsep f hf with hkill | hkill
+      · let phi : K none →* F := (p none).liftOfSurjective (hp none) ⟨f, hkill⟩
+        refine ⟨none, phi, ?_⟩
+        intro x
+        change f x = ((p none).liftOfRightInverse (Function.surjInv (hp none))
+          (Function.rightInverse_surjInv (hp none)) ⟨f, hkill⟩) (p none x)
+        rw [MonoidHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply]
+      · let fR : r.range →* F :=
+          r.rangeRestrict.liftOfSurjective r.rangeRestrict_surjective ⟨f, hkill⟩
+        have hdesc : ∀ x : G, fR (r.rangeRestrict x) = f x := by
+          intro x
+          change (r.rangeRestrict.liftOfRightInverse
+            (Function.surjInv r.rangeRestrict_surjective)
+            (Function.rightInverse_surjInv r.rangeRestrict_surjective)
+            ⟨f, hkill⟩) (r.rangeRestrict x) = f x
+          rw [MonoidHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply]
+        have hfR : Function.Surjective fR := by
+          intro a
+          obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf a
+          exact ⟨r.rangeRestrict x, (hdesc x).trans hx⟩
+        let pR : ∀ i : I, r.range →* K (some i) := fun i =>
+          (Pi.evalMonoidHom (fun j : I => K (some j)) i).comp r.range.subtype
+        have hpR : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (pR i) := by
+          intro i a
+          obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hp (some i) a
+          exact ⟨r.rangeRestrict x, hx⟩
+        have hsR : ∀ x y : r.range, (∀ i, pR i x = pR i y) → x = y := by
+          intro x y hxy
+          apply Subtype.ext
+          funext i
+          exact hxy i
+        obtain ⟨i, phi, hphi⟩ := ih r.range (fun i => K (some i)) pR hpR hsR fR hfR
+        refine ⟨some i, phi, ?_⟩
+        intro x
+        exact (hdesc x).symm.trans (hphi (r.rangeRestrict x))
+  exact hfinite B A (fun i => (Pi.evalMonoidHom A i).comp B.subtype) onto
+    (fun x y hxy => Subtype.ext (funext hxy)) theta theta_onto
+
+end NikolovSegal

+    letI := p.groupF

+
+abbrev arena : Arena where
+  signature := signature.{u,v,w}

+    (A : I → Type v) [hA : ∀ i, Group (A i)]
+    {F : Type w} [hF : Group F] [hS : IsSimpleGroup F]
+    (noncomm : ¬ ∀ x y : F, x * y = y * x)
+    (B : Subgroup (∀ i, A i))
+    (onto : ∀ i, Function.Surjective ((Pi.evalMonoidHom A i).comp B.subtype))
+    (theta : B →* F) (theta_onto : Function.Surjective theta),
+    ∃ i : I, ∃ phi : A i →* F, ∀ b : B,
+      R.readout () ⟨I,hI,A,hA,F,hF,hS,noncomm,B,onto,theta,theta_onto⟩ b = phi (b.val i)
+
+abbrev statement : Prop := type_of% @NikolovSegal.subdirect_simple_factorization.{u,v,w}
+
+theorem bridge : statement.{u,v,w} ↔ arena.{u,v,w}.Law actual := Iff.rfl
+
+private theorem inverse_cannot_factor (p : SourceData.{u,v,w}) : by
+    letI := p.groupA
+    letI := p.groupF
+    exact ¬ ∃ i : p.I, ∃ phi : p.A i →* p.F,
+      ∀ b : p.B, (p.theta b)⁻¹ = phi (b.val i) := by
+  letI := p.groupA
+  letI := p.groupF
+  rintro ⟨i,phi,hphi⟩
+  apply p.noncomm
+  intro a b
+  obtain ⟨x,rfl⟩ := p.theta_onto a
+  obtain ⟨y,rfl⟩ := p.theta_onto b
+  have hm : (p.theta (x * y))⁻¹ = (p.theta x)⁻¹ * (p.theta y)⁻¹ := by
+    rw [hphi (x * y), hphi x, hphi y]
+    exact phi.map_mul (x.val i) (y.val i)
+  simpa only [map_mul, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv] using congrArg Inv.inv hm
+
+private abbrev Base := alternatingGroup (Fin 5)
+
+private theorem base_noncomm : ¬ ∀ x y : Base, x * y = y * x := by
+  intro h
+  have hc : IsMulCommutative Base := ⟨⟨h⟩⟩
+  have hb := alternatingGroup.isMulCommutative_iff_card_le_three.mp hc
+  norm_num at hb
+
+private def testData : SourceData.{u,v,w} := by
+  let I := ULift.{u} Unit
+  let A := fun _ : I => ULift.{v} Base
+  let F := ULift.{w} Base
+  haveI : IsSimpleGroup F := (MulEquiv.ulift : F ≃* Base).isSimpleGroup
+  let B : Subgroup (∀ i : I, A i) := ⊤
+  let theta : B →* F := {
+    toFun := fun b => ⟨(b.val ⟨()⟩).down⟩
+    map_one' := rfl
+    map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
+  refine ⟨I,inferInstance,A,inferInstance,F,inferInstance,inferInstance,?_,B,?_,theta,?_⟩
+  · intro h
+    apply base_noncomm
+    intro a b
+    exact congrArg ULift.down (h ⟨a⟩ ⟨b⟩)
+  · intro i a
+    exact ⟨⟨fun _ => a, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩,rfl⟩
+  · intro a
+    exact ⟨⟨fun _ => ⟨a.down⟩, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩,rfl⟩
+
+private theorem rejected_law : ¬ arena.{u,v,w}.Law rejected := by
+  intro h
+  let p := testData.{u,v,w}
+  letI := p.finiteI
+  letI := p.groupA
+  letI := p.groupF
+  letI := p.simpleF
+  exact inverse_cannot_factor p
+    (h (I := p.I) p.A (F := p.F) p.noncomm p.B p.onto p.theta p.theta_onto)
+
+private theorem dependence : ObservationalDependence signature.{u,v,w} actual := by
+  intro i
+  let p := testData.{u,v,w}
+  letI := p.groupF
+  letI := p.simpleF
+  obtain ⟨a,b,hab⟩ := exists_pair_ne p.F
+  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := p.theta_onto a
+  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := p.theta_onto b
+  refine ⟨p,x,y,?_⟩
+  change p.theta x ≠ p.theta y
+  simpa only [hx,hy] using hab
+
+def family : Registration arena.{u,v,w} statement.{u,v,w} where
+  actual := actual
+  bridge := bridge
+  variation := ⟨bridge.mp @NikolovSegal.subdirect_simple_factorization,rejected,rejected_law⟩
+  sensitivity := ⟨fun i => ⟨rejected,
+    fun j hj => (hj (Subsingleton.elim j i)).elim,rfl,rejected_law⟩,
+    fun e => nomatch e⟩
+  dependence := dependence
+
